"""Check exact V158 readiness bytes,sources,historical control and document links."""

import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V158-regional-dc-v1'
index=repo/'docs/results/v158-regional-dc-preparation-v1.json'
output=repo/'docs/results/v158-regional-dc-preparation-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
publication=read(index);assert len(publication['copies'])==12 and publication['source_texts']==33
for copy in publication['copies'].values():
    for role in ['original','public']:assert ref(copy[role]['path'])==copy[role]
    assert Path(copy['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(copy['public']['path']).read_bytes()
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json');guard(post)
assert post['independent_metric_import']['returncode']==0
bundle=read(publication['sources']['path']);assert ref(publication['sources']['path'])==publication['sources']
assert len(bundle['source_texts'])==33 and len(bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'])==87
for item in bundle['source_texts']+[bundle['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
for p,h in bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(p)['sha256']==ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
    assert ref(Path(plan['work'])/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
ready=read(root/'readiness-audit-v2.json')
assert ready['finite_Adam_states_at10']==90 and ready['strict_raw_EMA_CPU_loads']==4
assert ready['restored_control_raw_EMA_Adam_exact_V157'] and not ready['CUDA_initialized']
assert ready['all90_parameter_tensors_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients']
assert ready['complete_rows']==ready['exact_control_trace_rows']==218
assert ref(ready['live_prefix']['path'])==ready['live_prefix']
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(ready['live_prefix']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
reference=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace'];assert len(rows)==218
for n,row in enumerate(rows):
    assert row['step']==n+1 and row['batch']==reference[n]['batch']
    old=reference[n]['arms']['spatial-rgb']
    assert {k:row['arms']['dc-control'][k] for k in old}==old
assert read(root/'objective-tests-v1.json')['tests']==56
failure=read(root/'readiness-audit-failure-v1.json')
assert failure['error']=="KeyError('local-risk')" and failure['observed_exit_code']==1
assert not failure['training_restarted'] and failure['new_neural_forward_calls']==0
assert ref(failure['source']['path'])['sha256']==failure['source']['sha256']
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json')
assert parity['component_forward_evaluations']==56 and len(parity['rows'])==28
assert all(r['exact_frozen_spatial_forward_and_archived'] for r in parity['rows'])
design=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')
assert len(design['observations'])==822 and len(design['endpoints'])==4
assert design['new_component_forwards']==3288
for item in design['observations']:
    assert ref(item['arrays']['path'])==item['arrays'] and ref(item['parent']['path'])==item['parent']
assert len(post['retained_native_collections'])==2
for binding in post['retained_native_collections'].values():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    collection=read(binding['path'])
    assert len(collection['observations'])==822 and collection['module_before']==collection['module_after']
    assert collection['RNG_unchanged']
    for case,row in zip(design['observations'],collection['observations'],strict=True):
        assert row['id']==case['id'] and row['parent']==case['parent']
        assert ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction']
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md',
      'docs/regional-dc-regret.md','diary/2026-11-07-01-34-28-v158-regional-dc.md']
links=0
for name in docs:
    p=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        target=(p.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert target==output or target.is_file(),(name,link)
        links+=1
save(output,{'status':'pass-immutable-readiness-sources-prefix-retained-comparators-and-documents',
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'publication':ref(index),'byte_exact_receipts':12,'source_texts':33,
    'unchanged_neural_hashes':87,'new_neural_modules':0,'actual_CPU_tests':56,'actual_CUDA_compatibility_calls':56,
    'restored_smoke_Adam_states':90,'exact_historical_control_trace_rows':218,
    'retained_V156_comparator_arrays_checked':1644,'fixed_quality_cases':822,'fixed_endpoints':4,
    'document_links_checked':links,'documents':{p:ref(repo/p) for p in docs},
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forward_calls':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Actual completed readiness receipts,frozen sources,historical exact V157 control prefix,all supplied quality files and retained V156 native bindings. Original auxiliary reporter failure preserved and corrected. Final training,quality and actual native viewing remain pending;no restoration or safety gain inferred.'})
print('PASS12 exact receipts,33 source texts,87 unchanged neural hashes,218 exact control rows,1644 retained arrays and',links,'links')
